### Hypersnap Seam Routing - Doc 2418 D6 (Thu Oct 22)

The biggest infrastructure move of the week. All major read domains in ZAOOS now route through the Hypersnap seam:

- Farcaster: failover logging per read-base failover, three wrong read paths fixed (PRs #4133, #4134)
- Social feed reads through the seam (PR #4138)

- hypersnap-probe: read-only liveness check for the Hypersnap read base (PR #4135)

The seam is now observable. Every failover logs a line. The probe checks liveness without requiring traffic.

## Best Ideas This Week

1. **The seam as a single observable choke point** - Every read domain going through Hypersnap means one place to add caching, one place to fail over, one place to measure. Simple architectures beat distributed ones.
2. **The research library as a build queue** - Docs 2418, 2689-2691, 2699-2701 all started months ago and all shipped this week. Writing the doc first is the fastest path to shipping.
3. **Ultracode tiering: "Opus plans, Haiku scans, Sonnet ships"** - Doc 2701 captured the model. Every build should run on the cheapest surface that can do it well.

## Farcaster/X Thread Draft (5 posts)

**Post 1:**
We routed every major ZAOOS read domain through the Hypersnap seam this week. Social feeds, member profiles, artist data, music channel content -- all through one observable choke point. Every failover logs a line. Build-in-public means building observable.

**Post 2:**
ZAO TCG Cards went from "Phase A plan" on Monday to "UI live and first recipient list in" on Wednesday. The first ZAO TCG Card goes to WaveZ Station buyers. Music + onchain collectibles. That's the intersection we're building at.

**Post 3:**
10+ rules updates shipped this week. Not glamorous, but this is how you build an autonomous system that does not break: every time something breaks, you add a rule that prevents the exact shape of the break. The rules file is the agent's immune system.

**Post 4:**
The ZAOOS graduation map (doc 2691) is live. The repo was 12+ surfaces 6 months ago. It is going to 4. COC Concertz already graduated. ZAOstock and XMTP are next. When a product is ready for production + ready to share + ready to attract new users, it leaves. Until then, it lives in the lab.

**Post 5:**
Three research docs shipped this week on building agents from first principles. Doc 2699 is a ZAO agent built from scratch, every line explained. The model: Opus plans, Haiku scans, Sonnet ships. The cheapest surface that can do the work well. That's the whole frame.
